title: The Archive of Love
author: Sreekala Sivasankaran
text:
Uncharted walk,
back toward the home of memory,
and the past rises to meet up,
canvas-stretched and still.
The flowers and leaves bear their wounds,
torn and scattered by hurricanes.
And still, how beautiful —
held now in the quiet frame
of a village built from passion`s archive.
Walk hand in hand, without restraint,
free spirits unbound.
No fear. No secret codes.
No hidden photographs.
In the end,
perhaps it`s hard to find one honest in love.
But the one
who loves
with soul laid bare,
unwavering, and entire.
